summary.text: Patrick McCracken, a Libertarian Party financial advisor who describes himself as a fourth-generation Montanan, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Montana's 2nd Congressional District to Troy Downing.
He worked as a financial advisor for about 10 years and has spent roughly 20 years or more helping people with their financial planning.

paragraphs.text: Patrick McCracken says he is 48 and has lived in Montana his whole life as a fourth-generation Montanan; he graduated from Billings West High School and attended school in Bozeman.

He worked as a financial advisor for about 10 years, left the state for work for a period, and says he has spent roughly 20 years or more helping people with their financial planning, now in a work-from-home job.
McCracken, who is from Columbia Falls, mentions his wife and kids in a Montana Public Radio interview.
He became the Libertarian nominee without a primary opponent after the June 2, 2026 Libertarian primary was canceled.
During the campaign, he ran on cost of living, health insurance and food prices.
He received 1.8% of the vote to Troy Downing's 58.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
